footer.aboutText: Nkhedmou.ma connects hospitality and catering professionals with the establishments hiring in Morocco.

about.intro1: Nkhedmou.ma — “nkhedmou” means “we work” in Darija — came out of a simple observation: in Morocco, cooks, bakers, pastry chefs and hotel staff still find work by word of mouth, while restaurants and hotels struggle to recruit qualified people.
about.intro2: Our aim is to bring these two worlds together in one place, with a platform that is simple, secure and built mobile-first, because that is where most of our users are.
about.candidatesBody: Build a complete profile or generate your CV directly on the platform, then apply to offers near you. Registration is free.
about.employersBody: Post your offers, filter profiles by city, sector, position and experience, and save the candidates who interest you.
about.verifiedBody: Every job offer is checked and approved by our team before it is published. Candidates' contact details are protected.
about.languagesBody: The whole platform is available in French, Moroccan Arabic and English, so that language is never a barrier.

privacySections.title: What data do we collect?
body: At registration we collect only your first name, last name, email address and password.

When you complete your profile you may add your phone number, city, sector, position, experience, training, previous roles, a profile photo, a CV and, for certain kitchen and pastry trades, photos of your preparations.

privacySections.title: Protecting your contact details
body: Your phone number is never displayed publicly. It is accessible only to verified employers, under the platform's recruitment rules.
Every employer access to your contact details is recorded and traceable by the administration.
Employers also have an option to hide their own phone number from candidates.

privacySections.title: Uploaded files
body: CVs and photos are checked before being stored: file type, size and image quality are all verified.
Files that do not match the permitted formats are rejected. A CV must be a PDF, DOC or DOCX file and must not exceed 5 MB.
The administration may remove any inappropriate photo and block an account in the event of repeated abusive uploads.

privacySections.title: Activity log
body: The platform keeps a history of significant administrative actions, of access to candidates' contact details and of photo uploads.

privacySections.title: Moderation of offers and profiles
body: All job offers are checked and approved by the administration before publication.
You are notified on the platform and by email when your profile or your offer is approved.

privacySections.title: Your rights
body: You may view, correct or delete your profile information at any time from the “Edit my profile” page.
For any request concerning your data, write to us at contact@nkhedmou.ma.

privacyIntro: This policy explains what data Nkhedmou.ma collects, how it is used and how it is protected.

termsSections.title: 1. Purpose of the platform
body: Nkhedmou.ma connects professionals in catering, bakery-pastry and hospitality with the establishments recruiting in Morocco.
The platform is an intermediary: it is not the employer and is not party to the employment contract agreed between a candidate and an establishment.

termsSections.title: 2. Registration and account
body: Registration is free and requires a first name, last name, email address and password.
Your password must contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit and one special character.
After three failed sign-in attempts your account is temporarily suspended and a verification code is sent to you so you can reset your password.
You are responsible for the accuracy of the information in your profile.

termsSections.title: 3. Visitor access
body: Visitors who are not registered may view the first page of offers and profiles. Viewing a full offer or profile requires creating an account.

termsSections.title: 4. Job offers
body: All offers posted by employers are checked and approved by the administration before becoming visible to candidates.
The maximum publication period for an offer is 60 days. After that the offer is automatically removed from the active offers.
An expired offer remains available in the employer's history, together with the applications received, and can be republished.
The administration reserves the right to refuse, amend or withdraw any non-compliant offer.

termsSections.title: 5. Published content
body: You warrant that you hold the rights to the photos and documents you upload.
Photos of culinary preparations are reserved for kitchen, bakery and pastry trades, and are limited to 8 photos per profile.
The administration may remove any inappropriate content and block accounts in the event of repeated breaches.

termsSections.title: 6. Confidentiality of contact details
body: Candidates' phone numbers are not public and are accessible only to verified employers, under the platform's recruitment rules.
Every access to contact details is recorded and traceable.
Using contact details for cold outreach, resale or bulk collection is strictly prohibited and results in account closure.

termsSections.title: 7. Advertising
body: The platform displays advertising space. Nkhedmou.ma is not responsible for the content or offers of third-party advertisers.

termsSections.title: 8. Contact
body: For any question regarding these terms: contact@nkhedmou.ma

termsIntro: By creating an account on Nkhedmou.ma, you accept the terms set out below.
